prd_version_inspected: AI_Skin_Analysis_V2_PRD (Phases 1-7, Functional Requirements FR-01 through FR-20)

hospital_requirements_clarification.rationale: The PRD establishes the application strictly as an educational, non-diagnostic skin analysis tool. It mandates contextual emergency triage recommendations (e.g. advising emergency room or dermatologist consultation upon red flag symptoms), but does NOT specify an interactive GPS/GIS facility locator, maps integration, or hospital directory.
contextual_recommendations_implemented: Urgent medical attention is advised. Please consult an emergency department, urgent care center, or a qualified healthcare provider immediately.
Timely medical consultation is recommended. Schedule an appointment with a board-certified dermatologist or primary care physician.
Consider consulting a dermatologist for a professional evaluation.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Image Upload & Input Validation
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Relies on standard browser input; 10MB client-side cap.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Prevents processing of malformed/corrupted files.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Browser Camera Capture
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Automated verification uses mocked MediaStream APIs; physical device testing unverified.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Privacy: Camera tracks immediately terminated upon unmount.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Image Capture Coaching
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Advisory only; does not enforce user compliance.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Helps user provide usable, non-blurry, evenly illuminated photos.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Pre-Inference Image Quality Assessment
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Fixed Laplacian threshold (<100) and luminance range (40-220).
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Halts inference before running CNN on degraded inputs.

requirements_status_matrix.name: 7-Class CNN Inference (EfficientNet-B0)
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: 7 classes only; sensitive to single-video frame correlation (vitiligo IMG-0951).
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Strictly non-diagnostic preliminary classification.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Top-3 Ranked Probabilities & Margins
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: None.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Transparent probability margins highlight close calls.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Confidence & Uncertainty Quantification
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Based on Softmax probabilities; no Bayesian or MC-Dropout uncertainty.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Categorizes into High (>=0.8), Medium (0.6-0.8), Low (<0.6).

requirements_status_matrix.name: Explainability via Grad-CAM Visual Heatmaps
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Base64 overlay image generated from final convolutional layer.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Highlights salient lesion regions for user transparency.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Symptom Questionnaire Ingestion
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Preserves unanswered/unknown states; does not alter CNN logits.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Severe symptoms escalate triage to attention/urgent.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Deterministic Safety & Triage Engine
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Deterministic rule set; cannot be bypassed by high model confidence.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Enforces emergency flag and consult guidance.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Educational Disease Knowledge Presentation
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Static database for 7 dermatological conditions.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Purely informational, non-prescriptive content.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Model Abstention & Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Handling
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Escalates safety level when confidence is low, but lacks explicit non-skin rejection guardrail.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Risk of confident hallucination on non-dermatological inputs.

requirements_status_matrix.name: AI Explanation via Gemini API with Guardrails
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Requires valid network and API key; strictly guarded output schema.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Safety: Forbids diagnostic assertions and treatment advice.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Deterministic Fallback for Explanations
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Static pre-reviewed explanation templates.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Reliability: Prevents application lockup if LLM call fails.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Unified Analysis Response Composer
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: None.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Reliability: Unified contract between backend and React client.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Accessible UI / UX & Multi-Device Journey
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard navigation verified; real mobile device browser tests not performed.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Accessibility: Screen reader and keyboard accessible.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Analysis History Persistence & Querying
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: SQLite local database without cloud synchronization.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Privacy: Preserves records locally; raw images not stored.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Clinical Summary Export (PDF & CSV)
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Export limited to single-page PDF and summary CSV.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Legal/Privacy: Mandates explicit educational disclaimer watermark.

requirements_status_matrix.name: User Feedback & Privacy Deletion Controls
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Bulk history deletion implemented; per-record deletion not wired in UI.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Privacy: User maintains full control to purge history.

requirements_status_matrix.name: Clinical Validation & Institutional Oversight
requirements_status_matrix.remaining_gap: Requires institutional IRB approval, real-world clinician trials, and prospective studies.
requirements_status_matrix.safety_privacy_clinical_implications: Clinical: Strictly non-diagnostic prototype until trials are executed.

recommended_next_task.title: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) & Abstention Guardrail Engine
recommended_next_task.scope: Implement skin-detection heuristic and feature-distance thresholding to detect non-dermatological / non-skin images and abstain before CNN prediction.
recommended_next_task.risk: Low (preserves model weights and existing 7-class contract).
